context7_usage.reason: Pure repo-local wiring of two already-existing local contract modules (launch_queue_contract.py, launch_queue_persist.py) into an already-live FastMCP server instance, mirroring an already-implemented local pattern (cli_adapter_readonly_tool.py). No external MCP-SDK/API question was open.

summary: Wired launch_queue_contract.py's describe_intent/evaluate_launch and launch_queue_persist.py's read_persisted_log as 3 new READ-ONLY @mcp.tool()s in server.py: geoai_launch_queue_describe_readonly, geoai_launch_queue_evaluate_readonly, geoai_launch_queue_audit_summary_readonly. Neither source module was modified (both excluded from this task's allowed_writes) -- server.py imports them directly and calls their existing pure functions, mirroring the B106 cli_adapter_readonly_tool read-only-view pattern without adding a register()-style helper to either module. describe_intent is always called with audit=False (its only write-refusing path); evaluate_launch and read_persisted_log have no write path in the first place. launch_enabled()/LAUNCH_IMPLEMENTED stay hardcoded False, unchanged and unread as toggles by these tools.

invariant.audit_summary_delegates_to: launch_queue_persist.read_persisted_log (plain file read, never creates the log)

public_api.geoai_launch_queue_describe_readonly(tas: dry-run intent+decision dict via launch_queue_contract.describe_intent(audit=False); writes nothing
public_api.geoai_launch_queue_evaluate_readonly(tas: LaunchDecision dict via launch_queue_contract.evaluate_launch; permitted always False
public_api.geoai_launch_queue_audit_summary_readonl: read-only summary via launch_queue_persist.read_persisted_log; counts + last N entries

neural_bridge_note: This wiring adds no new decision authority: describe/evaluate/audit_summary are pure views over an already-disabled contract (launch_enabled() hardcoded False). The eventual adapter/runner/topic SELECTION for any future launcher remains scoped to MCP_NEURAL_LAUNCH_ROUTING_MIGRATION_V1 (a learned routing + abstain policy), never a regex/keyword cue router; the static LAUNCHABLE_BINARIES/KNOWN_ADAPTERS allowlist stays a human-configured safety boundary underneath it.
no_launch_code_marker: server.py, launch_queue_contract.py, and launch_queue_persist.py contain no process-launch code: no subprocess import, no child-process spawn, no os-level exec/fork/spawn/system/popen, no shell invocation, no network/API call.
